verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API exposes audience resources, and its root resource links to all other resources. A full account export endpoint gives an agent a programmatic way to pull the program in bulk. The evidence never shows API endpoints for reading live automations or campaign reports: open/click reporting and Analytics AI's "what's working" insights are documented as in-app features, not agent-accessible data. Missing for 10: documented automation-read endpoints, campaign report/analytics API endpoints, agent-specific access (e.g. an official MCP server or agent guides), independent hands-on corroboration.
